description:
YOUR HOME

Create a space that’s uniquely yours in this unfurnished two-bedroom apartment at Sherlock Quarter. Designed with modern living in mind, the home features a bright, open-plan kitchen, dining and living area with integrated appliances and plenty of natural light. This home is a versatile hub for entertaining, hybrid working or unwinding at the end of the day. Both bedrooms benefit from built-in storage and their own private bathroom, with the principal bedroom featuring an en-suite. Offering flexibility for shared living, a home office or additional living space, this apartment is ideal for couples, sharers or anyone looking for a little more room.

YOUR NEIGHBOURHOOD

A dynamic, new neighbourhood, Sherlock Quarter offers a collection of shared spaces and services designed to be an extension of your home. Start your mornings in the on-site gym, fully equipped with cardio and weight equipment, or join the weekly workout classes in the fitness studio. Pet-friendly living is a breeze at Sherlock Quarter, with private courtyards and podium gardens providing outdoor spaces to enjoy throughout the neighbourhood. Work remotely in one of the dedicated co-working spaces and spend evenings relaxing in the plush resident lounges in the 29th floor Sky Lounge. Discover the best views across Birmingham and beyond. Your friendly on-site team includes concierge and dedicated maintenance to make day-to-day living seamless.

YOUR LOCATION

Within walking distance of the Bullring and key public transport routes, Sherlock Quarter is here to put you front and centre. Living in the heart of the Birmingham City Centre and just a 14-minute walk from New Street Station, Sherlock Quarter provides you with easy access to Wolverhampton, Coventry, Leicester, London, and beyond.

THE FINE PRINT:

Photos are for illustrative purposes only - layouts and features may vary. A Security Deposit equal to five weeks’ rent, or taking a deposit alternative product from our partner, Reposit, is required. Reposit is offered as an alternative to a traditional cash deposit and is subject to successfully passing referencing with HomeLet. Get Living will receive a commission where Reposit is selected. The deposit will be held by the Tenancy Deposit Scheme. Pet friendly: all applicants with a pet must sign our pet policy agreement. Council tax band: D  (Birmingham City Council to confirm at point of move-in).

Utilities:

Glide Wi-Fi is included in the rent. All other utilities including electricity to be paid separately by the resident(s) directly to the provider. Sherlock Quarter homes are heated by electricity and charged by household usage. Homebox will appoint the initial supplier with the option to change providers and should notify Get Living. A metered water supply is provided by Severn Trent and charged based on usage. Hot water usage will be charged via Homebox with no option to change provider.

Additional information:

Secure bike storage, at no extra cost. Parking is available to rent at additional cost and subject to availability, ask our team for more information.

Accreditation:

Sherlock Quarter is a member of the Propertymark Client Money Protection Scheme. Get Living is a member of The Property Ombudsman, an independent dispute resolution scheme.

T&C's:

Please read all of our terms and conditions on the Get Living website
